description: A UTF-16 .xml with a stray last byte fails in Tika (XML parse error, no text, as the xberg factbook-utf-16.xml does) and in ripstream (Malformed XML) (tikajs-dmp7). Tika 4.2.0 oracle (PUT /rmeta/body, filename page.xml). The body is empty: Tika fails before it reports an event (tikajs-bhvl).
